sources.title: Metaplanetary
sources.author: Publishers Weekly, 2001
sources.read_scope: Grist, human-derived forms, inner dictatorship and outer diversity.
sources.limitations: Nanotechnology and political differences do not settle resident necessities or labor-independent allocation.

sources.title: Superluminal
sources.author: Publishers Weekly, 2004
sources.read_scope: The war continues between inner and outer systems; the published sequel has no final resolution.
sources.limitations: The discovery label post-conflict civilization is unsupported; do not invent a concluded third volume.

sources.title: Ware Tetralogy
sources.author: Wikipedia contributors, Kiwix mirror
sources.access_method: Public indexed Software, Wetware, Freeware and Realware entries read
sources.read_scope: Bopper independence, moldie succession and the distinct later alla gift.
sources.limitations: Different periods cannot borrow Realware's universal fabrication device. Robot societies still need a justified person denominator and actual distribution mechanism.

sources.title: Freeware
sources.author: Worlds Without End, publisher-description reproduction
sources.read_scope: Moldies as evolved artificial lifeforms and social conflict.
sources.limitations: The page contains inconsistent 2053/2953 dates; no exact date is adopted. Artificial life alone is not post-work economics.

sources.title: Postsingular by Rudy Rucker
sources.author: Fantasy Hive, 2021
sources.access_method: Public indexed nants and orphid-era setting discussion read
sources.read_scope: Distinct technological transformations rather than one stable singularity state.
sources.limitations: An information and consciousness transformation does not settle material production or ordinary access.

sources.title: Notes for Postsingular
sources.author: Rudy Rucker, 2007
sources.access_method: Public indexed orphidnet and material-sharing notes read
sources.read_scope: Proposed sharing of leftovers, discovery of unused goods and AI assistance.
sources.limitations: Working notes include tentative and rejected ideas; not treated as enacted institutions in the finished novel. No PDF or novel read attempted.

sources.title: Interzone 220: After Everything Woke Up
sources.author: Tangent Online, 2009
sources.read_scope: A related story presents ubiquitous sentience and anticipates Hylozoic.
sources.limitations: Related-story context only, not a verified material-economy account of the finished novel. Other stories in the issue are excluded.

decisions.reason: Inner-system grist and dictatorship do not settle the population's actual production and access arrangement.
decisions.analysis: Nanotech embodiment and transport do not prove labor-independent necessities or deliberate preservation of unnecessary jobs.

decisions.reason: Outer-system freedom and diverse persons do not by themselves establish a post-work economy.
decisions.analysis: The outer coalition cannot inherit a uniform distribution rule from opposition to the Met.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading; require a concise material-support account to reopen.

decisions.reason: The proposed post-conflict scope is not verified by the published sequel account.
decisions.analysis: The review explicitly describes an unresolved war installment. A future peaceful economic settlement cannot be supplied from the discovery label.

decisions.reason: Bopper autonomy is established, but a robot society is not automatically a post-work society.
decisions.analysis: The short account does not identify a nonworking human-derived population supported by autonomous production or an equivalent justified proxy.
decisions.follow_up: Keep as a robot-personhood comparison; skip deeper reading.

decisions.reason: Moldie evolution and social exclusion do not establish a labor-independent provision system.
decisions.analysis: Artificial biological embodiment and unusual materials cannot substitute for actual economic rules or a clear person denominator.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading; do not borrow the later alla device.

decisions.reason: Orphid information access is clear, but durable material provision is not established in the short published account.
decisions.analysis: Finding leftovers or unused goods through an information network differs from verified automatic production. Tentative author notes cannot fill the finished story's institutional gaps.

decisions.reason: Ubiquitous sentience does not yet establish the finished Hylozoic population's material support.
decisions.analysis: The related-story review verifies a premise, not who produces necessities or controls their distribution in the novel.
decisions.follow_up: Skip deeper reading; no speculative working-note rescue.

decisions.reason: The broad human-Earth lead conflates different Ware periods and technologies.
decisions.analysis: Bopper independence, moldie society and the later alla gift are separate stages. No concise account establishes one common human post-work arrangement across them.
decisions.follow_up: Skip the aggregate; a later clear Realware-specific community can be a distinct lead.

review_notes: Eight quick dispositions without reading novels or reconstructing tentative author drafts.
Discovery labels are hypotheses: Superluminal does not establish the proposed post-conflict order.
Rucker working notes are labeled as tentative, not substituted for the finished novels.
Nonhuman embodiment alone does not satisfy the economic admission rule.
